hybrid_runtime_unavailable: recall_arms.runtime writes synthetic jobs/messages on every retrieval call; it cannot compose on the supplied store under this lane's no-store-write contract. Measure runtime separately as the runner's baseline.

costs.note: Process-cold includes pin verification/import/session load; OS cache not flushed. Warm load is first main-process load, cached acquisition is a second cache lookup. Peak RSS is process high-water mark, not incremental model allocation.

recall_at_k_definition: Micro recall = sum needed refs in first k unique eligible ranked refs / sum needed refs, separately per split and kind. Cases with no needed refs add zero to numerator/denominator (all-empty groups: null). Vector: full cosine rank; hybrid: RRF of exact lexical list and full cosine rank before min_sim/top_k/empty-only admission. Baselines expose only their returned rank (no additional cutoff).
